assert (root/'pubspec.lock').read_bytes()==(base/'pubspec.lock').read_bytes(),'dependency lock mismatch'

 for backdrop in (['plain','wallpaper'] if round%2 else ['wallpaper','plain']):

   for revision in (['baseline','current'] if round%2 else ['current','baseline']):

    args=['flutter','test','--no-pub',f'test/perf/{bench}_bench.dart','--reporter','expanded']

     result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env={**os.environ,'MARKSTREAM_RUN':str(round)},stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)

     print(text[-5000:],flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
directories = {'baseline': root/'.scratch/backdrop-base',
               'reviewed': root/'.scratch/backdrop-reviewed-28f4e4b4',
               'current': root}
out = root/'.scratch/backdrop-perf-review-triple'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
harness = ['test/perf/markstream_render_bench.dart', 'test/perf/timeline_scroll_bench.dart',
           'test/perf/long_streaming_bench.dart', 'test/support/markdown_backdrop_host.dart']
for path in harness + ['pubspec.lock']:
    assert all((folder/path).read_bytes() == (root/path).read_bytes() for folder in directories.values()), path
source_paths = subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','a8364707','--','lib','dependencies/markstream/lib'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
data = {'revisions': {'baseline': 'a8364707', 'reviewed': '28f4e4b4', 'current': 'working tree after independent review'},
        'sdk': subprocess.check_output(['flutter','--version'],text=True),
        'hardware': subprocess.check_output(['sysctl','-n','machdep.cpu.brand_string'],text=True).strip(),
        'harnessSha256': {p: hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in harness},
        'productionSha256': {p: hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in source_paths},
        'runs': []}
orders = [['baseline','reviewed','current'], ['current','baseline','reviewed'],
          ['reviewed','baseline','current'], ['current','reviewed','baseline'],
          ['baseline','current','reviewed']]
for index, order in enumerate(orders):
    for backdrop in (['plain','wallpaper'] if index % 2 == 0 else ['wallpaper','plain']):
        for revision in order:
            args = ['flutter','test','--no-pub','test/perf/markstream_render_bench.dart',
                    '--dart-define=MARKSTREAM_PROFILE_PHASES=true','--dart-define=MARKSTREAM_BENCH_CYCLES=5','--reporter','expanded']
            if backdrop == 'wallpaper': args += ['--dart-define=MARKSTREAM_BENCH_WALLPAPER=true']
            label = f'{index+1}-{backdrop}-{revision}'
            print('Running '+label,flush=True)
            start = time.monotonic()
            with (out/(label+'.log')).open('w') as log:
                result = subprocess.run(args,cwd=directories[revision],env={**os.environ,'MARKSTREAM_RUN':str(index+1)},stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            lines = [line for line in (out/(label+'.log')).read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('MARKSTREAM_RENDER ')]
            assert result.returncode == 0 and len(lines) == 1, label
            data['runs'].append({'round': index+1,'backdrop': backdrop,'revision': revision,'command': args,'exitCode':result.returncode,
                                 'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'result':json.loads(lines[0].split(' ',1)[1])})
            (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2))
rows = []
for backdrop in ['plain','wallpaper']:
    values = {revision: {} for revision in directories}
    for run in data['runs']:
        if run['backdrop'] != backdrop: continue
        sample = run['result']
        metrics = {k:v for k,v in sample.items() if k.endswith('Us') and isinstance(v,(int,float))}
        for phase in ['coldPhaseUs','contentPhaseMedianUs','contentPhaseP95Us']:
            metrics.update({phase+'.'+k:v for k,v in sample[phase].items()})
        for k,v in metrics.items(): values[run['revision']].setdefault(k,[]).append(v)
    for metric in values['baseline']:
        raw = {revision: values[revision][metric] for revision in directories}
        assert all(len(v)==5 for v in raw.values())
        middle = {revision:median(v) for revision,v in raw.items()}
        rows.append({'backdrop':backdrop,'metric':metric,'rounds':raw,**middle,
                     'vsBaselinePct':100*(middle['current']/middle['baseline']-1),
                     'vsReviewedPct':100*(middle['current']/middle['reviewed']-1)})
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
print('Completed 30 processes; all five rounds retained.',flush=True)
